sum: Amesite Inc., a technology company, engages in the development and marketing of B2C and B2B AI-driven solutions in the United States. The company products include Amesite Engage, that leverages proprietary AI infrastructure, offering cutting-edge applications that cater to both individual and professional needs; and LynkMagic, provides enterprise AI solutions for healthcare and related organizations. It also provides NurseMagic, mobile healthcare app, streamlines creation of nursing notes and documentation tasks, enhances patient communication, and offers personalized guidance to nurses on patient care, medications, and handling challenging workplace situation. Amesite Inc. is headquartered in Detroit, Michigan.
ceo: Dr. Ann Marie Sastry Ph.D. (Chairperson, President & CEO)
